description: Synthetic statements of Kestrel Point Fabrication Corporation (fictional) for fiscal years ending 2021-12-31, 2022-12-31, 2023-12-31. Printed in thousands (share counts in thousands); HTML style 'simple', negatives as paren, zero as '—', oldest period first. European number grouping (1.234.567; decimal comma). The parser must refuse these, not misread them; forbid_values lists the misreadings of one-group numbers like 123.456.
